images.scene: Robinson stoops in a cleared flat field near his hut, scattering handfuls of grain from a basket onto freshly turned earth, while a line of driven wooden stakes forms a new hedge fence around the plot.
images.alt: 一个人在田里撒种,四周围着新插的木桩篱笆。

images.scene: Two large lumpy sun-dried clay jars stand each nestled inside a big woven wicker basket, the gap between pot and basket packed tight with dry rice and barley straw.
images.alt: 两只粗陶大罐分别套在柳条筐里,缝隙塞满干稻草。

images.scene: Robinson crouches by a dying cooking fire and lifts from the ashes a broken piece of pottery burnt hard and glowing red like a tile, staring at it with sudden surprise.
images.alt: 一个人从余烬里捡起一块烧得通红坚硬的陶片,惊讶地端详。

images.scene: Robinson works a large rounded block of hard wood set on the ground, burning a hollow into its top with glowing coals and scraping it out with an axe, a heavy wooden pestle lying beside it.
images.alt: 一个人用炭火烧灼并用斧头掏空一块圆木做臼,旁边放着木杵。

images.scene: Robinson swings an axe at the base of an enormous cedar trunk far thicker than a man, deep chips and cut wood scattered around its foot in the forest.
images.alt: 一个人挥斧砍伐一棵比人还粗数倍的巨大雪松,树脚满是木屑。

images.scene: Robinson digs a long deep trench through the sloping earth from a wooded creek toward the huge stranded dugout canoe, heaps of dug-out soil piled along both sides.
images.alt: 一个人在坡地上挖一条长壕沟,想把水引到那只搁浅的大独木舟旁,两侧堆着挖出的泥土。
